situation.headline: Converging Iranian-Houthi campaign targeting Saudi oil infrastructure and Red Sea shipping lanes is driving crude above $101/bbl and threatening a supply shock that will destabilize the global economy, directly undercutting US strategic equities across every theater simultaneously

domains.name: Middle East
domains.label: regional escalation 90d
domains.status: Iran-Houthi axis has struck Saudi oil port at Yanbu, downed multiple US drones over Hormuz, attacked a tanker twice, and fired toward Mecca for the first time, while Washington resists Riyadh's requests for direct military intervention, leaving Saudi Arabia increasingly exposed and the coalition fraying

domains.name: Indo-Pacific
domains.label: China coercion escalation
domains.status: Beijing's sharp public protest over US on-orbit offensive weapons deployment signals intent to match or escalate in the space domain, and Middle East energy disruption provides China strategic leverage as the US is tied down in two other theaters

domains.name: Europe
domains.label: NATO cohesion fracture
domains.status: NATO jets shooting down a drone over the Baltics and continued Russian operations during Ukraine ceasefire negotiations indicate pressure but not yet fracture, though Boris Johnson's public push against strategic ambiguity on Ukraine status suggests growing Western impatience with the negotiation framework

domains.name: Energy
domains.label: supply shock 60d
domains.status: Diesel at record $6.23/gal, crude up 19% in three weeks to $101, Yanbu loadings suspended, the Strait of Hormuz under active kinetic threat, and Chevron CEO confirming market buffers are exhausted — a classic supply shock is already in motion, not merely at risk

domains.name: US Politics
domains.label: House flip Nov 2026
domains.status: Polls show Democrats gaining edge as Trump drags down GOP, Kansas described as in play, redistricting offers Republicans zero gain, and rising gas prices plus immigration controversy compound Republican vulnerability ahead of midterms

situation.unseen: The simultaneous suspension of Saudi oil exports at Yanbu, Iran's active targeting of US surveillance assets over Hormuz, and the confirmed deployment of US offensive space weapons have created a three-domain escalation ladder — sea, air, and space — that Iran and its proxies can exploit asymmetrically; the pattern suggests Tehran is deliberately stress-testing US crisis management bandwidth across all three domains at once, betting Washington will not open a fourth front, and markets are only pricing the energy leg of this while the space and drone dimensions remain under-analyzed
situation.criticalWindow: The next 30 days are decisive for Saudi Arabia: if Houthi-Iranian strikes successfully interdict Yanbu exports or ignite infrastructure at the port, MBS faces an impossible choice between accepting Iranian deterrence of Saudi oil exports or formally requesting US combat intervention — a decision that will define the entire regional order and force the Trump administration to choose between a costly military commitment and a catastrophic oil price spike heading into midterm season
watchFor: Physical damage to Yanbu port oil loading infrastructure or confirmed sustained suspension of Saudi crude exports beyond 72 hours
A fourth US drone downed or first direct Iranian strike on a US naval asset in or near the Strait of Hormuz, which would trigger CENTCOM escalation authority
Saudi Arabia formally invoking mutual defense provisions or requesting US air campaign against Houthi launch sites, forcing a White House decision

Crude oil breaking and holding above $110/bbl, which historical models associate with US recession onset within two quarters and would collapse Trump's domestic political position ahead of November 2026
situation.confidenceNote: Key uncertainties include the actual throughput damage at Yanbu versus a precautionary suspension, whether Iran is directing Houthi strategic targeting or merely enabling it, the true readiness status of US naval assets in the Fifth Fleet AOR after reported base damage, and whether the Trump administration's resistance to direct intervention reflects a deliberate negotiating posture toward Iran or a genuine capacity constraint; prediction market data here is heavily weighted toward US domestic politics and provides limited signal on Middle East escalation dynamics
situation.topPattern: The convergence of Iran striking a tanker twice in the same month, Houthis firing toward Mecca for the first time and triggering Yanbu alerts, crude at $101 with Chevron confirming buffer exhaustion, and Kalshi showing the Trump bull-case-2026 contract collapsing to 3% tells a single story: the Iran-Houthi axis has correctly read that the US will not intervene directly, and is now executing a deliberate campaign to price Saudi Arabia out of the energy export market and Trump out of domestic political viability simultaneously

signals.headline: Saudi Arabia suspends Red Sea oil loadings at Yanbu after pipeline attack; crude hits $101, diesel $6.23 record
signals.summary: Houthi attacks on East-West pipeline triggered Saudi suspension of Yanbu port operations. US crude up 19% in three weeks. Chevron CEO confirms strategic reserves buffer 'largely played out.' Gasoline and diesel inflation imminent.
signals.signal: US inflation trajectory now hostage to Yemen proxy conflict. Trump admin faces immediate political cost (pump prices spike before 2026 midterms) if Red Sea disruption persists. MBS increasingly pressuring Trump for direct US military intervention, which risks broader Iran escalation.
signals.contradicts: Market assumption that Middle East conflict remains compartmentalized and manageable without supply shock.

signals.headline: Iran downs third US drone in Strait; missile threat detected over Mecca for first time; El Gaia tanker attacked
signals.summary: IRGC claims third MQ-1C downing over Hormuz. Saudi Civil Defense activated across Yanbu, Jazan, Abha signaling imminent barrage. El Gaia struck by Iranian missile last month, now damaged again by drone. First-ever missile alert over Islam's holiest city.
signals.signal: Escalation spiral is accelerating faster than US restraint can contain. Iran demonstrating both capability and willingness to strike US assets and Saudi holy sites. Saudi internal security perceptions shifting—MBS cannot absorb another Mecca incident politically. Direct US-Iran kinetic conflict now higher-probability than market prices reflect.
signals.contradicts: Assumption that Iranian strikes remain calibrated signaling; recent tempo and targeting suggest doctrine shift toward sustained pressure.

signals.headline: Harris 2028 nomination odds collapse to 8% (down from 44% run likelihood); Newsom/Ossoff climb
signals.summary: Kamala Harris Democrat nominee probability at 8% (minimal movement in 24h). But her willingness-to-run dropped 36 cents to 45% in parallel market. Gavin Newsom (13% nominee, 50% will run) and Jon Ossoff (17% nominee) show relative strength.
signals.signal: Democratic field is fragmenting without clear frontrunner. Party establishment signal weakness heading into midterm cycle. Trump's tariff/trade volatility and Middle East instability create opening for anti-incumbent messaging, but Dem bench looks shallow on foreign-policy credibility.
signals.contradicts: Prior narrative of Harris consolidating progressive base; markets now price her as polarizing drag on Dem ticket.

signals.headline: US Space Force confirms first-ever deployed offensive weapons in orbit; China and Russia warnings issued
signals.summary: Air Force Secretary Troy Meink publicly confirmed US has 'on-orbit space control weapons' deployed for first time. No technical details released. China demands US 'stop preparing for war in space.' Russia responds space must remain 'weapon-free.'
signals.signal: Unilateral US disclosure of space weapons capability signals confidence in technological edge but accelerates arms-race dynamic in orbital domain. China/Russia will treat this as justification to operationalize their own systems. Escalation in new warfighting domain now kinetic.
signals.contradicts: Prior diplomatic posture of ambiguity; explicit acknowledgment suggests Trump admin prioritizing deterrence signaling over arms-control framework.

signals.headline: Ukraine strikes Russian Taganrog aerospace facility; Putin relocates Valdai conference from Sochi citing drone fears
signals.summary: Ukrainian cruise missile attack on Beriev aerospace complex; NASA FIRMS detected major fire. Putin moved annual Valdai conference from Sochi to Moscow, citing Ukrainian drone threat. Putin absent from Sochi since October 2025.
signals.signal: Symbolism matters: Putin's retreat from Sochi signals Kremlin vulnerability to deep-strike capability and erodes his domestic security brand. Ukrainian confidence in long-range precision rising. Russia-Ukraine war is not in negotiation stasis despite Lavrov rhetoric; offensive tempo by both sides intact.
signals.contradicts: Narrative of frozen conflict and diplomatic off-ramps; battlefield momentum and strategic initiative remain contested.

signals.headline: Marco Rubio VP nomination odds rise to 29% (up 3 cents); Trump administration seen locking in security team
signals.summary: Rubio Republican VP nominee probability at 29% with upward momentum. J.D. Vance GOP presidential nominee at 46%, gaining. White House Press Secretary market shows Scott Jennings (23%, +2 cents) and Maria Bartiromo (15%) in contention.
signals.signal: Trump consolidating foreign-policy and national-security messaging through personnel locks. Rubio elevation reflects priority on hemispheric/counter-China posture. Market pricing suggests cabinet stability is being telegraphed as response to Middle East/Ukraine volatility.

scanNote: Signal quality degraded by headline-only context; OSINT feeds show real-time escalation in Red Sea/Hormuz but lack damage assessment specificity; prediction markets show clear fragmentation on Dem 2028 field and Trump admin continuity pricing.

markets.label: Recession in 2027
markets.rationale: Oil at $101/bbl with diesel at record $6.23/gallon, Yanbu suspended loadings, Chevron CEO warning buffers are exhausted, and Houthi attacks on Red Sea infrastructure create a serious stagflationary shock that materially elevates 2027 recession risk above the market's 25% price.

markets.label: Newsom 2028 Dem nominee
markets.rationale: Newsom leads the Democratic field at 13% on Kalshi and benefits from Trump approval drag on the GOP per polling, but the 'running' market showing him at only 50% suggests significant field uncertainty that keeps his nomination probability modest.

markets.label: Ossoff 2028 Dem nominee
markets.rationale: Ossoff is priced at 17% nomination odds — surprisingly high for a first-term senator with no national profile — making this market likely overpriced relative to fundamentals; current intel provides no specific catalyst supporting his rise.

markets.label: AOC 2028 Dem nominee
markets.rationale: Dems gaining edge per polls and progressive energy is real, but AOC faces structural electability concerns and a crowded field; her 16% market price appears modestly inflated absent a major galvanizing event.

markets.label: Rubio 2028 GOP VP nominee
markets.rationale: Rubio's VP odds spiked 3 cents to 29% today, possibly driven by his high-profile role managing Iran/Middle East escalation as Secretary of State, but VP selection is inherently unpredictable and Vance's incumbency as VP complicates this market's logic.

markets.label: Vance 2028 GOP Presidential nominee
markets.rationale: Vance at 46% on Kalshi is the clear Republican frontrunner as sitting VP and heir apparent; the Middle East crisis and economic turbulence could help or hurt depending on resolution, making his true probability roughly in line with the market price.

markets.label: Trump bull case scenario 2026
markets.rationale: With oil above $100, diesel at record highs, housing mortgage rates near 7%, Houthis threatening Yanbu and the East-West pipeline, Warsh pushing for rate hikes, and Democrats gaining in polls, virtually every macro and geopolitical indicator is running against a Trump bull case scenario resolving by December 2026.

watchSignals: Houthi missile/drone campaign tempo against Saudi oil infrastructure (Yanbu loadings suspended, air raid warnings activated) — escalation threshold for US direct intervention decision
Iran drone/missile attrition rate vs US CENTCOM air defense — cumulative losses will force Tehran doctrine adjustment or signal commitment to sustained proxy campaign

Oil price trajectory: crude at $101 (+19% in 3 weeks), diesel $6.23/gal record, Chevron CEO signals inventory buffers depleted — next supply shock or geopolitical flare triggers immediate stagflation scenario

Trump administration response to Saudi requests for direct military intervention — currently resisting, but sustained Houthi attacks on Mecca/holy cities will create domestic political pressure for escalation
Ukraine-Russia energy infrastructure agreement status and enforceability — Trump claim of bilateral commitment vs Zelenskyy non-commitment signals potential negotiation leverage collapse
US space weapons deployment confirmation and Chinese/Russian counter-messaging — Space Force acknowledgment of on-orbit offensive capability raises kinetic escalation risk in peer conflict

groundTruth.headline: Houthis have achieved sustained maritime interdiction capability in Red Sea and Gulf of Aden; Saudi Arabia suspending loadings at Yanbu and activating early warning systems for missile threats to Mecca for first time in conflict
groundTruth.summary: Houthi operational reach has escalated to direct threat to Islam's holiest city and Saudi Arabia's primary oil export port. This marks a threshold shift from harassment to strategic targeting. Saudi Crown Prince MBS faces internal legitimacy pressure and external escalation dilemma.
groundTruth.signal: US will face imminent choice between accepting regional oil market volatility or committing air/naval assets to direct Houthi suppression — politically costly either way for Trump administration

groundTruth.headline: Iran has conducted simultaneous multi-vector attacks: missile/drone strikes on US bases (hundreds of structures damaged per watchdog), downed or claimed downing of multiple US drones (MQ-1C over Strait of Hormuz), missile strike on tanker El Gaia, drone strikes on Kurdish positions in Erbil
groundTruth.summary: Iran is conducting coordinated offensive operations across air, maritime, and proxy domains without initiating direct escalation to declared war. This signals Tehran believes it has calibrated response level below US red lines for major retaliation.
groundTruth.signal: US must decide whether to treat coordinated Iranian strikes as isolated incidents or pattern indicating new baseline for Iranian aggression; affects nuclear talks, sanctions strategy, and CENTCOM force posture

groundTruth.headline: Crude oil has risen 19% in three weeks to $101/barrel; diesel at record $6.23/gallon; Chevron CEO states inventory buffers that protect markets have largely depleted; Costco rationing motor oil; EXXON refinery power outage under investigation; East-West pipeline threatened
groundTruth.summary: US energy market shock absorbers are exhausted. Any further Middle East disruption, pipeline damage, or refinery outage will translate directly to consumer prices and inflation. Market lacks redundancy.
groundTruth.signal: Stagflation risk is now function of geopolitical events, not Fed policy; Trump administration will face domestic political pressure to either stabilize Middle East or release strategic reserves; affects 2026 midterm messaging and 2028 general election dynamics

groundTruth.headline: Trump claimed Ukraine and Russia agreed to refrain from targeting each other's energy infrastructure; Zelenskyy immediately contradicted this, stating Kyiv has not formally committed without assurances; Boris Johnson stated strategic ambiguity on Ukraine NATO membership is the core problem
groundTruth.summary: Trump's negotiation authority over Ukraine is contested and public. This signals either diplomatic overreach or Zelenskyy's refusal to constrain Ukrainian strike doctrine without NATO guarantees. Framework for any Trump-brokered settlement is cracking before it solidifies.
groundTruth.signal: US credibility with both sides is degraded; if settlement talks proceed, Ukrainian military will likely continue energy targeting regardless of political agreements, creating escalation spiral that contradicts stated Trump goal of rapid conflict resolution

groundTruth.headline: Trump has made more stock trades than all of Congress combined; reports cite $50M data center donation for lease arrangement; Don Jr Russian-funded wedding probe; Warsh Fed confirmation now at 'showdown' phase; housing market stagnant with 7% mortgage rates imminent
groundTruth.summary: Governance legitimacy signals are degraded across executive, cabinet, and financial markets. Family conflict-of-interest patterns and personnel loyalty tests (Warsh Fed pressure) suggest internal Trump administration cohesion stress. Economic headwinds (rates, housing) unresolved.
groundTruth.signal: Market confidence in Trump administration policy consistency and institutional independence is declining; creates opening for congressional/judicial checks on executive authority; affects Trump 2028 succession dynamics (Vance markets at 46% nom, 23% general)

groundTruth.headline: Pentagon revealed for first time that US has deployed offensive weapons in space; China and Russia issued warnings; Putin relocated Valdai conference from Sochi due to Ukrainian drone threat (first Sochi visit avoidance since Oct 2025); Ukraine struck Taganrog Beriev aerospace facility with cruise missiles
groundTruth.summary: US has operationalized space weapons capability and publicly confirmed it; Russia is operating under legitimate drone threat inside its own territory; Ukraine is striking Russian aerospace/defense manufacturing. Escalation ladder rungs are visible and being climbed sequentially.
groundTruth.signal: Peer conflict escalation is now multi-domain; US strategic signaling on space weapons creates deterrent credibility but also lowers threshold for Chinese/Russian counter-escalation; increases risk of accidental kinetic conflict in space or via proxy
